newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bonds seen vulnerable to new selloff.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bonds seen vulnerable to new selloff.

text.p: Belgian bonds ended lower on Friday as worries about early French elections hit OATs in Paris and the OAT/Bund yield spread widening caused the OLO/Bund differential to widen as well.
New supply at Monday's OLO auction BELA, where the new January 2000 and existing March 2007 OLOs are up for sale, also pushed the spread out.

OLOs are seen vulnerable to new selloffs, which could be triggered by further bond weakness in the U.S., but also by signs of economic vigour in Europe. Some players worried that the two-year-old uptrend might be ripe for a major correction.
